home.intro: A platform to recognize, analyze, and understand historical documents through artificial intelligence.
home.reading: From image to meaning, with a clear approach assisted by AI.
home.featuresTitle: A clearer approach to old documents
home.recognizeText: Identify the characters, lines, and structures of a manuscript.
home.analyzeText: Explore the visual and textual elements of a digitized document.
home.understandText: Bring out the context and the important information.
home.transcribeText: Make the text found in the manuscript easier to read.
home.step1Text: Share an image or a scan of your document.
home.step2Text: Structures, lines, and notable elements are picked out.
home.step3Text: Browse the useful information with a fresh look.
home.step4Text: Save the document and its results so you can find them again later.
home.bannerText: Discover an experience designed to bring history, the image, and artificial intelligence closer.
home.footer: Recognize, analyze, and understand historical documents
